title: Development and production are different builds, with different output locations
statement: In Next.js 16.3.2, `next dev` and `next build` produce different builds: development output goes to `.next/dev` and production output to `.next`, and the two can run concurrently without conflicting.
notes: ⚠️ THIS IS THE CLAIM THAT MAKES AST-0010 MATERIAL rather than cautious. If dev and production were the same artifact, validating under `next dev` would validate what ships. They are not, so a validation run against the development server says nothing about the production build — which is exactly why #137 deferred AST-0010 while the deployment mode is undeclared, and why declaring production mode makes it owed rather than optional.
